A '''battle''' in the [[Thanium sector/Legends|Thanium sector]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] took place in [[3639 BBY]] during the the [[Galactic War]]. [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warlord [[Rimark]] stole the construction plans for the [[Void Anvil]], a secret Republic mining station and shipyard, and attempted to sell them to the Empire at a minefield in the Thanium sector.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==The battle==
The [[Coruscant Aegis]] squadron was sent to intercept Rimark and was almost immediately ambushed by a pair of [[Plug-6 heavy fighter]]s, defeating them whilst approaching the minefield. Bypassing a [[Unidentified freighter class|Mandalorian frigate]] and damaging a [[Terminus-class destroyer|''Terminus''-class destroyer]], the Coruscant Aegis began to pursue the [[Imperial shuttle]], which was escorted by Rimark himself, piloting a [[D5-Mantis Patrol Craft]], and two further Plug-6 fighters. During the intense dogfight among the systems asteriods, the shuttle carrying the plans, Rimark and his fighters were destroyed. The Imperial destroyer subsequently moved to escape the asteroid field and jump to hyperspace but was also destroyed by the Coruscant Aegis before it could do so.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Thanium Disruption is a heroic Republic-side space mission in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
